ALREADY_INITIALIZED().details: Error thrown if the contract has already been initialized.

NOT_ENOUGH_TOKENS().details: Error thrown if the sender does not have enough tokens.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `amount` tokens is approved by `owner` to be used by `spender`.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `amount` tokens is transferred from `from` to `to`.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the EIP-712 domain separator for the EIP-2612 permit.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the amount of tokens that `spender` can spend on behalf of `owner`.

approve(address,uint256).details: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's tokens. Emits a {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the amount of tokens owned by `owner`.

deposit(address,uint256,bool).details: If _doEarn is false, a fee is taken from the deposit to incentivize the next call to `earn`.If _doEarn is true, the incentive token amount (if any) is added to the total amount, the incentive token amount is reset, and the total is deposited into the strategy.

params._amount: The amount of tokens to be deposited.
params._doEarn: If true, deposits LP tokens directly into the strategy.
params._receiver: The address for which the deposit is made.

initialize().details: Reverts if the contract has already been initialized.

returns._liquidityGauge: The liquidity gauge used by the contract.

nonces(address).details: Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value is used to compute the signature for EIP-2612 permit.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over the tokens of `owner`, authorized by a signed approval by `owner`. Emits a {Approval} event.

returns._strategy: The strategy used by the contract.

returns._token: The ERC20 token used by the contract.

totalSupply().details: Returns the amount of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Transfer `amount` tokens from the caller to `to`. Requirements: - `from` must at least have `amount`. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `amount` tokens from `from` to `to`. Note: Does not update the allowance if it is the maximum uint256 value. Requirements: - `from` must at least have `amount`. - The caller must have at least `amount` of allowance to transfer the tokens of `from`. Emits a {Transfer} event.

params._shares: The amount of shares to be withdrawn.

DENOMINATOR().notice: The denominator used for percentage calculations.

EARN_INCENTIVE_FEE().notice: A small fee charged to incentivize the next call to the earn function.

decimals().notice: Returns the decimals of the contract. (ERC20)

deposit(address,uint256,bool).notice: Deposits a specified amount of LP tokens into the contract.

incentiveTokenAmount().notice: The total amount of the incentive token.

initialize().notice: Initializes the contract by setting allowances for the token and liquidity gauge.

liquidityGauge().notice: Returns the liquidity gauge used by the contract.

name().notice: Returns the name of the contract. (ERC20)

strategy().notice: Returns the strategy used by the contract.

symbol().notice: Returns the symbol of the contract. (ERC20)

token().notice: Returns the ERC20 LP token used by the contract.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Withdraws a specified amount of LP tokens from the contract.
